description: This is a Python source file defining a text-to-speech (TTS) service implementation called HathoraTTSService. It provides classes, methods, and functions to interact with Hathora-hosted TTS models, process audio data, and perform TTS synthesis by making API requests. It includes internal utility functions for audio decoding and a class that manages TTS requests, configuration, and metrics.
